headline.text: Login from a new location: Bandung

context.text: Attendance: Andi is on a work trip to the Bandung branch office, 2–4 October.
No reports of strange calls or emails from Andi.

explanation: The location is new, but Andi really is on a work trip to Bandung, using his registered office laptop, and he passed MFA normally. Resetting his password here would only get in the way of his work.
hints: A new location is not always an attack. Check the extra info.
The device is registered and there is a work trip record. Is anything still odd?
